notes: Fully customizable: 'Set your drawdown (4-14%), profit target, and payout (80/90/100%)'. The captured numbers are the DEFAULT configuration shown on the pricing page (6% drawdown / 80% split). Prices for other drawdown/split combinations are not published in readable form and were not captured.

The E8 One help-centre article documents a different 'preset account' (6% profit target, 3% daily drawdown, 4% dynamic drawdown) and states 'This information is for the preset account. You can still customize some of the parameters at checkout.' The pricing page default is 6% drawdown / 9% target / 4% daily. These two official pages are inconsistent about which configuration is the preset - flagged, not reconciled.

Payout minimum: 'Your net profit (payout share) must be greater than 50% of your daily drawdown. Example: If you have a $100,000 account and your daily drawdown is 4%, the minimum amount required for a payout is $2,001.'
Leverage: Forex 1:30, Indices 1:15, metals 1:15, Crypto 1:1.

Customizable at checkout: drawdown 6/8/10% and profit split 80/100% (API: "drawdowns":[6,8,10],"profit_splits":[80,100]). Prices recorded are the base 8% drawdown / 80% split configuration only.

2% daily profit cap applies in both stages: '2% Daily Profit cap - In each day, the maximum profit you can make is 2%. If you make more, only 2% will be counted towards your profit target. For a $100,000 account, that's $2,000 profit cap per day.'

payoutFirstDays left null: no explicit day count is published. The site states payouts can be requested daily with 'Minimum profit for first and additional payouts: 1% of your initial balance' and 'On-demand does not apply to E8 Pro and E8 Zero models, as these products have daily payouts.' The firm's own JS config carries firstPayout:1 but that value is not published in human-readable copy, so it is not recorded.
Payout mechanism: 'first, 50% of your total profits is set aside as your requestable amount. Then, depending on your chosen plan, you receive up 100% of that amount.'
Leverage: Forex 1:30, Indices 1:15, metals 1:15.

maxLossPct left NULL on purpose: the max loss is not a single percentage, it varies by account size. Verbatim: '$1,000 EOD - $25,000 account / $2,000 EOD - $50,000 account / $3,000 EOD - $100,000 account / $4,500 EOD - $150,000 account' (= 4% on $25K and $50K, 3% on $100K and $150K). The product page hero states '3-4% EOD drawdown'.

dailyLossPct left NULL on purpose: there is NO daily loss limit in the challenge stage. On the Performance account there is a soft limit, not a breach: '2% Daily pause - A soft daily loss limit based on your starting balance of the day. If your floating or closed loss reaches 2%, trading stops until the next day. Your account is not breached.'

minTradingDays left NULL: no minimum trading days figure is published for the challenge stage. For payouts: 'Minimum profitable days between each payout: 5 (does not apply for first payout)' and 'A profitable day is considered as a day where the realized closed PnL equals to 0.3% or more.'
maxTradingDays: 'Unlimited Trading Days - There is no time limit but you need to place and close at least one trade each 60 days.'
Minimum payout $100: 'Minimum payout is $100. Amounts are taken from your net profit. Meaning, with 80% payout, you need to request at least $125.'
Payout buffer: 'Before you can start requesting payout, you need to leave a buffer in your account in the same size as your EOD Dynamic Drawdown. The buffer can not be requested.'

Payout caps apply (published table on https://e8markets.com/e8-signature): 1st/2nd payout $1,000 ($25K), $1,250 ($50K), $2,250 ($100K), $3,250 ($150K); rising to $1,500 / $3,250 / $4,250 / $5,250 from the 5th payout onward.

Weekend/overnight 'Not allowed' is taken from the firm's own product comparison table (Weekend Holding: No; Overnight holding: No for E8 Signature) and corroborated by the forced daily flat at 23:00 server time. Note the firm's separate article 'Can I hold positions overnight and trade over the weekend?' lists only E8 One / E8 Pro / E8 Zero as allowed and does not mention E8 Signature at all.
Leverage: Forex 1:30, Indices 1:15, metals 1:15.
